michael: quick follow-up from the security all-hands thread \u2014 dropping unanswered Qs about SOC2/ISO evidence, KMS, VPC exports.
anita: thanks. first Q auditors asked: can exported evidence include a signed attestation and a human-readable chain-of-custody?
ryan: yes. plan is signed manifest + request metadata (requested_by, ticket, purpose, timestamp, sha256). manifest will sit next to bundle in the tenant bucket.
carol: example manifest snippet (backend signs this): ```{
  "bundle_id": "bndl-2289990000-01",
  "requested_by": "anita",
  "request_ticket": "SEC-789",
  "purpose": "ISO audit",
  "timestamp": "2026-09-10T18:03:12Z",
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "signer": "redwood-svc-key-v2"
}```
michael: good. who owns the implementation?
ryan: infra owns manifest + bucket immutability (owner: ryan, due: 2026-09-24).
anita: legal wants a `request_reason` free-text field and an audit_record id for chain of custody. add both.
carol: done. next: KMS rotation history \u2014 can customers see rotation events and who triggered them?
ryan: cloud KMS: yes (rotation timestamps + actor id). BYOK/HSM: we'll include vendor attestation files per rotation; format TBD.
anita: action: scope HSM attestation schema (owner: anita + ryan, due: 2026-10-08).
michael: VPC flow logs: customer asked for sample policy to stream to their SIEM.
carol: we'll publish an infra recipe + least-privilege IAM example. sample CLI: ```redwood infra export-flow-logs --vpc vpc-abc123 --to s3://cust-bucket/flow/ --role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/RedwoodExportRole```
ryan: owner: carol, due: 2026-09-20.
michael: one more: cross-region failover \u2014 do logs replicate automatically?
carol: metadata and manifests replicate; raw logs replicate based on customer's replication setting. if replication disabled we add a "replication_note" to the manifest.
evidence-bot: Deployment: evidence-service v4.0 rolled out by ryan at 2289990090.
anita: please add owners and publish a short confluence page. i'll review retention language for public docs.
michael: owners recap:
- Implement signed manifest + chain-of-custody fields (ryan, 2026-09-24)
- Publish flow-log export recipe + IAM samples (carol, 2026-09-20)
- HSM attestation schema + pilot scope (anita + ryan, 2026-10-08)
- Public-facing retention FAQ draft (anita, 2026-09-28)
michael: thanks all. i'll close once confluence link is posted.
carol: :thumbsup:
